items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: He played with Miele in there man.

ctx.x: No the one playing clarinet. He's still on Orleans Street. What that fella used to play by the Pat out? I know him there too George. He's a pretty good guy. George Lewis? George Lewis. Me and Mr. Bum together. Oh yeah sure George. I know George Lewis. He used to play with uh. He played with Miele in there man. George Lewis.
I wanted to ask you to get back to the lawn parties again. Did they charge charge something to get in the lawn party?
